newsitem.title: USA: Inland to pay $10.1 mln for Uinta Basin.
newsitem.headline: Inland to pay $10.1 mln for Uinta Basin.

text.p: Inland Resources Inc said Monday it will buy Enserch Exploration's interest in 153 oil and gas well properties in the Uinta Basin of Utah for for $10.1 million in cash.
The companies said in a joint statement that the effective date of the purchase is March 31 with the closing expected to occur on August 15.

In addition to the wells, the deal also tranfers 12,000 net acres including 9,600 undeveloped acres, the water rights and a water and transportation and distribution system from Enserch to Inland, the companies said.
